rv.q: Top Girls has never seemed more hilarious, or wrenching.
But it's lit up by fine, bruising performances, not least Katherine Kingsley's bright, brittle Marlene.
In each section there is something extraordinary. Yet the movement of Turner's production is sometimes flaccid, and I am no longer convinced that this is Churchill's best play.
Lyndsey Turner's overstretched, underpowered revival... focus and laughs are lost.
If Act I has not bored the audience into a rigid coma, the next scene completes the job.
Lyndsey Turner directs an enjoyable version of this over-rated work.
